# Figma Antigravity Plugin (`figma-plugin`)

An Antigravity plugin integrating **Figma** with AI agents using native **Node.js**.

It bundles:
1. **Figma MCP Server & Sidecar**: Launches the Model Context Protocol server alongside the local WebSocket relay (`port 3055`) that interfaces with Figma.
2. **`figma-designer` Skill**: Gives agents clear rules and runbooks for creating frames, auto-layout, selecting typography/colors, and generating UI elements.

---

## Features

- **Pure Node.js**: Built on standard Node.js (`node:http` and `ws`). No Bun or external runtime required.
- **Automated Sidecar Management**: Automatically starts the WebSocket relay daemon in the background whenever the MCP server is called.
- **Auto-Layout & Design Standards**: Instructs agents to use standard device viewports, consistent spacing, and valid component structures.

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Install Dependencies (First Run)
In the plugin repository:
```bash
cd server && npm install
```

### 2. Install the Figma Community Plugin
In your Figma desktop app or browser:
- Install the [Talk to Figma MCP Plugin on Figma Community](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1485687494525374295/cursor-talk-to-figma-mcp-plugin).
- Open your Figma document, launch the plugin, and click **Connect**.

### 3. Enable in Antigravity

#### Option A: Project Level (`plugins.json`)
Add the plugin to your project's `.agents/plugins.json`:
```json
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "path": "~/.gemini/config/plugins/figma-plugin"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Option B: Global Settings
1. Go to **Settings** -> **Plugins**.
2. Find **`figma-plugin`** and toggle it **ON**.

---

## Directory Structure

```text
figma-plugin/
├── plugin.json         # Antigravity plugin manifest
├── mcp_config.json     # MCP server configuration
├── .gitignore          # Git exclusion rules
├── README.md           # Documentation
├── server/             # Pure Node.js MCP server & WebSocket sidecar
│   ├── start.sh        # Sidecar bootstrapper + MCP launcher
│   ├── socket.mjs      # Native Node WebSocket relay (port 3055)
│   ├── server.mjs      # MCP server bundle
│   └── package.json    # Standard npm dependencies
└── skills/
    └── figma-designer/ # Agent skill rules & guidelines
        └── SKILL.md
```

---

## Validation

Verify plugin integrity at any time using the Antigravity CLI:
```bash
agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/figma-plugin
```
